verdict: Paid campaigns went dark August 6; leads have fully stopped since.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns delivered 44 leads at $24.88 per lead through early August, then went dark on August 6 — no paid spend has run in 13 consecutive days. Every lead and every dollar of spend this period came from before that cutoff, so the back half of the window produced zero new paid leads. Your Google Business Profile continued generating organic activity — 55 calls and 158 total actions over the 28 days — but organic alone cannot replace paid volume at this scale. Campaigns are being reactivated this week, and you should expect new leads to resume once ads are live again.
